sidebar.emptyHint: Connect a Grafana to browse its dashboards here — they render natively, no Grafana login screen.
sidebar.sessionBadgeHint: Signed in with a Grafana session (SSO). PatchMan renews it automatically; sign in again if it expires.
sidebar.noDashboards: No dashboards visible to this account
sidebar.deleteDescription: The connection and every grant on it are removed from PatchMan. Nothing changes in Grafana.
sidebar.publicOnly: Signing in is required for the rest of this Grafana — only the public links are listed.

dialog.description: PatchMan reads Grafana through its HTTP API and draws the dashboards itself. Credentials are encrypted at rest.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.urlHelp: The address you open Grafana at, including any sub path (e.g. https://ops.example.com/grafana).
dialog.authTokenDesc: Works with every Grafana login. Created by a Grafana admin (Viewer role).
dialog.authBasicDesc: For local or LDAP Grafana accounts — you see what your account sees.
dialog.authSessionDesc: For SSO sign-in (GitLab, Google…) without a Grafana password.
dialog.tokenHelp: Grafana → Administration → Service accounts → Add service account (role Viewer) → Add token.
dialog.basicHelp: Works even when Grafana's HTTP Basic auth is disabled — PatchMan then signs in through the login form and renews the session itself.
dialog.ssoDesc: Opens Grafana's login page in a window; finish your usual SSO there and PatchMan keeps the session.
dialog.ssoCaptured: Signed in — session captured. Test or save the connection.
dialog.sessionHelp: In the browser where you are signed in to Grafana: DevTools → Application → Cookies → copy the value of grafana_session.
dialog.sessionNote: A session belongs to one backend: it is saved only on the backend selected below, which renews it automatically. If Grafana ends the session, sign in again.
dialog.backendLocalDesc: Requests go out from your machine (VPN, internal network).
dialog.backendRemoteDesc: Requests go out from the PatchMan server.
dialog.backendNote: The connection is saved on both backends; this picks which one runs it by default.
dialog.backendNoteSession: Session connections live only on the selected backend.
dialog.orgIdHelp: Only if your Grafana user belongs to several organizations.
dialog.cookieNameHelp: Only if Grafana's login_cookie_name was changed.
dialog.errSessionRequired: Sign in or paste a session first
dialog.authNoneDesc: Grafana with anonymous access, or dashboards shared by a public link.
dialog.publicLinksHelp: One per line: …/public-dashboards/<token>. Pasting such a link into the URL field adds it here.
dialog.noneNote: PatchMan visits Grafana as an anonymous viewer. Without anonymous access only the public dashboard links above are shown.
dialog.testOkPublicOnly: Connected — {{count}} public dashboard(s): {{titles}}. Everything else needs a sign-in.
dialog.urlResolved: Grafana answers at {{url}} — the URL was updated.
dialog.publicLinkDetected: Public dashboard link detected — the URL is set to Grafana's address and the link was added below.

share.title: Share "{{name}}"
share.description: Recipients view dashboards and run queries through this connection without seeing the credential. Read = raw SQL limited to read queries; write = any SQL in Explore.
share.identityWarning: This connection signs in as you (username/password or session). People you share it with will see Grafana with your permissions — prefer a service-account token for sharing.

dashboard.connectionGone: This Grafana connection is no longer available.
dashboard.authHint: Grafana rejected the credentials — edit the connection in the Dashboards sidebar (or sign in again for a session).
dashboard.renderError: This dashboard hit a display error. It has been reported; the rest of PatchMan keeps working.
dashboard.runQueryHint: Run your own query with this dashboard’s variables and time range
dashboard.publicHint: Shared by a public link — variables and ad-hoc queries are not available.

panel.unsupported: "{{type}}" panels are not drawn in PatchMan yet.
panel.transformationsIgnored: This panel uses transformations, which PatchMan does not apply yet.

time.hint: Use now-6h, now/d style expressions or a date (2026-10-19 10:00).

vars.cantList: PatchMan couldn't list this variable's values — showing the dashboard's saved values. You can also type a value.

explore.title: Explore
explore.empty: Write a query and run it.

inspector.jsonHint: Edit the whole query target as JSON (aggregations, options…)
inspector.varsHint: Runs with the dashboard’s variables and time range; edits here don’t change the dashboard
